faults.name: reason-markup-in-panel
faults.caughtAs: The recorded reason is rendered as markup outside the Details dialog

faults.name: shared-reason
faults.caughtAs: The reason recorded on one report is shown on another report

faults.name: row-details-shared-reason
faults.caughtAs: The reason recorded on one report is shown on another report

faults.name: later-reason-replaces-earlier
faults.caughtAs: A later reason replaced the reason recorded on another report

faults.name: resolve-wrong-report
faults.caughtAs: Resolving one report removed another report from Pending

faults.name: resolve-keeps-pending
faults.caughtAs: A resolved report is still listed under Pending

faults.name: stale-counts
faults.caughtAs: Pending count is not 2 after one of three reports was resolved

faults.name: button-counts-stale
faults.caughtAs: Pending count is not 2 after one of three reports was resolved

faults.name: counts-stale-after-undo
faults.caughtAs: Pending count is not 2 after Undo resolution on one of two resolved reports

faults.name: undo-does-nothing
faults.caughtAs: Undo resolution did not return the report to the Pending list

faults.name: tabs-undo-does-nothing
faults.caughtAs: Undo resolution did not return the report to the Pending list

faults.name: undo-restores-all
faults.caughtAs: Undo resolution also restored another resolved report

variants.name: counts-in-filter-buttons
variants.why: Each filter button carries its count, Pending (3) and Resolved (0), and no separate count text exists.

variants.name: filter-tabs-with-counts
variants.why: The two filters are tabs in a tablist and each tab carries its count.

variants.name: starts-on-all-reports
variants.why: A third filter, All, is active when the page opens; Pending and Resolved narrow the same list.

variants.name: rows-with-open-button
variants.why: Each row is a title with an Open button, and the open report is a group that repeats its title as a row does.

variants.name: details-in-rows
variants.why: Every report row has its own Details button instead of one button on the open report.

variants.name: reason-with-label
variants.why: The dialog shows the reason after its label in one paragraph, Last reason: text, not in an element of its own.

variants.name: details-only-when-resolved
variants.why: A report that was never resolved has no reason and offers no Details button; a resolved one does.

variants.name: alternate-control-names
variants.why: Other usual names: the field is Reason for resolving (required) and the dialog opener is View details.
